_about: Known advisories in what ships (npm audit --omit=dev) that were read and judged not to apply to how the middleware uses the package. scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI on any high or critical advisory not listed here, and on any entry past its reviewBy date. Reasons are recorded in docs/design/10-security-and-audit.md section 10.

exceptions.reason: Only the Prisma CLI loads it (@prisma/config), to read its configuration during migrate deploy. The flaw needs an Effect RPC server under concurrent load; nothing here runs one.
Only the Prisma CLI loads it (@prisma/config) to merge its own configuration. The flaw needs self-referencing objects; configuration read from files cannot contain them.

Unreviewed advisory naming zod 4 internals ($ZodArray); the middleware uses the zod 3 API. Input reaching zod is bounded or comes from known peers: browser forms by the 100 kB body limit, HL7 messages by the per-instrument maxMessageBytes, ASTM messages only from the instrument addresses allowed on the instrument network (ASTM has no total message cap yet). Revisit with the HMIS connector, whose responses must get a size limit too.
